sha256-hdi-v1:feb217409983bea0671b42ff1b.description: Bunny-eared warrior Ramy protects people and animals from hostile creatures, beginning aboard a penguin-filled ship. Jump, dash, and use her sword through side-scrolling action stages.
sha256-hdi-v1:feb217409983bea0671b42ff1b.title: Usagi na Panic

sha256-hdi-v1:febb854f704c0df656bfe02d9b.description: The Avatar is stranded on Pagan, a world under the Guardian's control. Explore its settlements and wilderness, master the elemental powers, and find a route home past the Titans.
sha256-hdi-v1:febb854f704c0df656bfe02d9b.title: Ultima VIII: Pagan
